JRT Group is a family-owned and operated throughout in Central Queensland. For over 20 years, JRT Group has shown a passion and a dedication for our work that has helped us to gain large numbers of satisfied clients. We offer everything from bulk earthworks to plant hire to our clients for a broad range of projects across the region. Our commitment to quality work and to each client we work with has made us one of the premier civil contracting companies in Central Queensland.

JRT Group is seeking qualified Fitters to join their team. The Fitter will assemble, install, maintain, and repair complex mechanical systems and equipment, ensuring they function safely and efficiently by interpreting technical drawings and fitting precise components.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret drawings and specifications
Fit and assemble mechanical parts, subassemblies, and equipment according to blueprints and technical drawings
Install machinery, equipment, and structural components with proper alignment and fit
Use various tools and machinery to assist in the assembly of a wide range of bulk material handling equipment such as conveyors, feeders and crushers
Will be fitting and assembling metal parts to fabricated production machines and other equipment
Will be using a range of tools and engineering techniques to maintain and repair mobile and fixed mechanical plant and equipment to operational standards
Utilise variety of hand tools (e.g., hammers, rulers), power tools, and measuring instruments to complete tasks accurately
Perform regular maintenance, conduct diagnostic tests on malfunctioning systems, and repair or replace defective parts to ensure proper function
Inspect components for accuracy and fit, and ensure that final assemblies meet safety and quality standards
Complete daily maintenance and repair logs
Adhere to and promote Workplace Health & Safety regulations
Report any hazardous situations and be aware of responsibility in the event of an emergency
Report any items requiring maintenance
Ensure that safety precautions are adhered to when using equipment
Access and have the ability to complete Job Risk Assessments

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certifications and qualifications
Proven experience working as a fitter
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Proficiency with hand and power tools
Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, fabrication, and installation processes
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the
workplace
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong communication, time management, and organisational skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual, and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Farnese Australia Pty Ltd. is seeking a full Time Service Technician to join our team based in Ingleburn NSW.

Reporting to the Services Manager, this is a hands-on, permanent role where you will play a key part in machine installations, preventive and breakdown maintenance. You will work across mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems, servicing machinery such as CNC Machine Centres, Bridge Saws, Block Saws, and Jib / Gantry Cranes.
This role offers variety and the opportunity to work both autonomously and within a team. While qualifications are not essential, any mechanical or electrical aptitude will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities:
•	Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance of machinery.
•	Install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Install and service equipment, including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic components.
•	Interpret electrical drawings and perform diagnostic checks.
•	Liaise with clients to understand and address service requirements.

What We Offer:
•	A permanent, full-time role in a supportive team environment.
•	A company vehicle for both work and personal use.
•	Opportunity for hands-on, technical work with diverse, cutting edge equipment.

Essential Criteria
•	Ability to interpret electrical and mechanical concepts and drawings.
•	Ability to install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Previous experience in machinery preventive maintenance.
•	Strong mechanical aptitude and fault-finding skills.
•	Excellent communication and client liaison skills.
•	Reliable work ethic with attention to detail and accuracy.
•	Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
•	Current driver's licence.
•	Minimum of less than 1 year of machinery preventive maintenance experience required.
•	Ability to interpret basic electrical symbols and drawings required.

Desirable Criteria:
•	Electrical fault-finding experience.
•	Knowledge of electrical control systems.
•	Experience with CNC machine technology and operation.
•	Background in the stone industry, manufacturing, or machinery service.

Renumeration: $85,000 - $105,000 + Super for the right candidate.

If you are looking for a hands-on, technically challenging role with the potential to grow and expand your skill set, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and become an integral part of our team at Farnese Australia.

Known as the “Tilt Slide Specialists,” the company combines industry experience, innovative engineering, and rigorous testing to deliver durable, reliable, and safe towing solutions built for demanding recovery operations. Based in Hervey Bay, Queensland, Bozmac is recognized for producing functional, heavy-duty equipment backed by quality craftsmanship and a strong reputation within the towing industry.

-Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans and technical specifications to determine manufacturing requirements.

Lead Educator (Full-Time) | $34.51 – $40.19 per hour | Chinchilla, QLD

Busy Bees is a leading global early learning provider, offering high-quality education in nurturing, purpose-built centres where educators are supported to grow, lead and make a real difference in children’s lives, with over 130 centres across Australia and around 3,000 employees.

Our Bee Safe Commitment: Child safety is at the heart of everything we do and is embedded in our people, places and processes. Help us give every child the Best Start in Life.

We’re seeking a passionate and experienced Lead Educator to join our team at Busy Bees at Chinchilla, located at 3 Braithwaite Street, Chinchilla QLD 4413, on a full-time basis. You will play a key role leading the daily learning program within your room, supporting educators, and creating a safe and engaging learning environment where children thrive. Sponsorship available for suitable applicants 482/494.

What you’ll do

Lead the planning and implementation of a high-quality educational program aligned with the EYLF
Inspire and mentor Educators within your room
Create a safe, inclusive and stimulating learning environment
Build strong, collaborative relationships with families and the local community
Ensure compliance with the National Quality Framework (NQF) and centre policies
Support children’s development, wellbeing, and learning outcomes through engaging play-based experiences

What you’ll bring

A genuine commitment to child safety, speaking up, always doing the right thing, and alignment with Busy Bees values
Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
Current First Aid, CPR, Asthma and Anaphylaxis certification
Current Working with Children Check for QLD
Demonstrated experience leading a room within an early learning environment
Strong knowledge of the EYLF and National Quality Standards (NQS)
A collaborative and supportive leadership style

Why Busy Bees?

Because we offer the B.E.E.S. advantage:Better pay. Everyday balance. Education for growth. Support you can rely on.We live by our values of Care, Quality, Service, and Value to make a real impact on child safety and quality.

12.5% above-award pay, Retention Payments & everyday extras; uniform and laundry allowances included, so your take-home pay stays yours.
Family-friendly benefits; 50% childcare gap-fee discounts for permanent staff, because your family should benefit too.
Paid learning & development; First Aid, CPR & mandatory training covered, ongoing professional development, and access to our Busy Bees learning platform and ACCCO RTO pathways.
Supportive leaders & inclusive teams; hands-on leadership, strong tenure and a culture built on trust, respect and collaboration.
Career pathways that grow with you; opportunities & training to progress from Educator to leadership, management and area roles.
Wellbeing support that goes beyond work; free, confidential EAP access for you and your immediate family, when you need it most.

Employment is conditional on satisfactory, rigorous pre-employment checks (including WWCC, ID, Qualifications, Gecko Training, Work Rights, NQAITS register/Prohibited Persons & References) and child safety training, reflecting our strong commitment to safeguarding, equity, diversity and inclusion.

We are proud to be a child safe organisation, putting child safety at the heart of everything we do through our Bee Safe commitment.

Apply now to join Busy Bees at Chinchilla and take the next step in your leadership journey within a supportive and high-quality early learning environment.

Force Equipment, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Emeco Group, is seeking suitably experienced and qualified trades personnel to join our workshop teams. o	Maintenance and repairs on Caterpillar, Liebherr, Elphinstone, Sandvik, Atlas Copco - Epiroc, Hitachi and Komatsu mobile equipment    within budgets and time frames
o	Working with the Force Equipment customers to meet their company objectives; and
o	Quality control on all work performed. 

Your Skills and Experience:

•	A strong commitment to safety

How to apply
Contact Nat on 0497 348 512 or natalie.marley@emecogroup.com for more info or click on 'Apply' and upload your CV today!
Emeco Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer - we encourage applicants who identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander to apply.

To learn more about Force job opportunities: https://forceequipment.com.au/careers
